outcome: The isolated FS migration candidate now guards legacy DFS review paths against stale canonical pointers, dynamically selects the installed delivery writer for a post-review handoff, and rebases the staged functional FS from the current active DFS while preserving functional content and ledger tracking. Active protected files remain unchanged.
summary: The candidate rejects stale FS redirects before legacy-lane validation and validates a valid redirect against canonical content. Its staged FS retains all 32 slice identities and the R-MAINT-CONSULT functional contract, contains no delivery-status markers, and its ledger includes the current integration assignment. The dynamic writer proof covers a long-lived supervisor's fresh on-disk delivery import before its sole successor. Full discovery is comparable to the baseline: candidate 453 and baseline 445 tests, each with the identical 5 failures, 19 errors, and 4 skips; the candidate adds eight tests without a new failing identity.
material_changes: Updated the isolated candidate mutation guard to resolve both legacy DFS roots through the shared canonical resolver before random-lane comparison.
Updated the isolated candidate supervisor to dynamically load the on-disk deadline-harness delivery writer after review and before the single successor handoff.
Rebased the isolated candidate FS/DFS pointer and ledger from current active documents, retaining pre-status functional contract text while removing delivery tracking from FS.
tests: Focused transition regressions: 11 tests passed (resolver/render, canonical guard, functional ledger projection, fresh delivery writer, long-lived supervisor lifecycle).
Dashboard staged compatibility: both source and deployed candidates passed legacy/canonical read-only, escaped rendering, and stale-pointer panel checks.
Candidate full discovery: 453 tests, 5 failures, 19 errors, 4 skips; baseline full discovery: 445 tests, 5 failures, 19 errors, 4 skips; the 22 failure/error identities are identical.
live_actions: No game, broker, coordinator, worker, dashboard, or supervisor process was launched or owned for this task.
No active method, active DFS/ledger, deadline state, mutation gate, or durable coordination record was modified.
evidence_ceiling: This proves only the isolated staged candidate, its regression comparison, and its dynamic-adoption design; it does not activate FS.md or prove a live parent has loaded the candidate.
The running active parent still holds the baseline DeadlineHarness import, so active promotion needs an exclusive reviewer-controlled parent replacement/exec or a verified pre-existing live hook.
